args: mkdir /packages && apk fetch --no-cache --recursive --output /packages $(cat /tmp/packages.lock)     && cd /packages && sha256sum *.apk > SHA256SUMS

apk add --no-network --no-cache /tmp/packages/*.apk     && mkdir -p /usr/local/share/otziv /usr/local/etc /etc/apache2/sites-enabled /sessions /var/run/apache2 /var/lock/apache2 /var/log/apache2     && cp /tmp/packages/SHA256SUMS /usr/local/share/otziv/apk-payload-sha256.txt     && cp /lib/apk/db/installed /usr/local/share/otziv/apk-installed-database     && rm -rf /tmp/packages     && delgroup www-data && addgroup -g 33 -S www-data && adduser -u 33 -G www-data -h /var/www -S -D www-data     && chown www-data:www-data /sessions && chmod 1777 /sessions     && ln -s /etc/php83 /usr/local/etc/php && ln -s /usr/bin/php83 /usr/local/bin/php     && ln -s /usr/sbin/httpd /usr/local/bin/apache2
mkdir /build-packages && apk fetch --no-cache --recursive --output /build-packages $(cat /tmp/build-packages.lock)     && cd /build-packages && sha256sum *.apk > SHA256SUMS

ln -s /usr/local/bin/apachectl /usr/local/bin/apache2ctl     && chmod 755 /docker-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/apache2-foreground     && apachectl configtest && php -v && php -m     && test "$(php -r 'echo PHP_VERSION;')" = '8.3.33'
